title: A round: rounds/<id>.md, YAML frontmatter only, after lowering. Each run entry is one segment.

name.description: What the start page and the run of show call the round.

segments.description: One entry per segment, in order, each naming one kind and what it runs, such as "- questions: all" with its minutes.

id.description: The entry's id:, else the slugged title. Unique in the round.

title.description: The entry's title:, else the referenced file's name.

kind.description: The entry's first key: script, questions, exercise, or a kind added later.

ref.description: The value of that key: one id, or a list for questions.

minutes.description: The entry's minutes:, else the referenced file's minutes.

frame.description: Copied from a script with frame: true. The segment is part of every interview, never an activity.

settings.description: Every other key in the entry. The kind's own settings schema checks it.
